title: REQ · Admin round handlers map service results and errors to exact statuses and JSON
summary: RoundHandler responds 200 for Get, 404 for ErrNotFound and 400 for bad input as unit-tested
description: Context: RoundHandler.Get, Open, Close map errors via statusFor. Desired behavior: each endpoint's success and sentinel-error statuses are asserted with fakes. Expected result: handler mapping regressions fail a test. Why: handlers must behave correctly once mounted.
acceptance_criteria: Given a fakeRounds returning a round, when GET /rounds/{id} is called, then 200 with the round JSON
Given a fakeRounds returning ErrNotFound, when GET /rounds/{id} is called, then 404
Given a fakeRounds returning ErrNotFound wrapped, when POST /rounds/{id}/open is called, then 404
